user_amendment: 另外步数，重复次数也可以删减。必须削减到个位数小时内
primary_contrast: joint_full vs human_full on all available source/target cell types in the same human test donors; 1000 updates x batch1024, no early stopping
secondary_budget_contrast: joint_human_exposure_matched vs human_full; match 1000 completed human updates; report selected updates plus extra compute
test_policy: All arms fixed before opening test metrics; no dropping negative arms; only validation selects checkpoints
primary_checkpoint: human brain validation mean(MMD+0.1*pseudobulk mean MSE)
protein_selection: lambda fixed at 1 for primary, .1 prespecified sensitivity; P5 validation only
units: brain donor/pool and CITE donor; seeds are optimization repeats, not biological replicates
gene_space: ALL 25790 original v2 nodes in checkpoint order, including multi-member orthogroups and species-private nodes; explicit assay masks; no HVG truncation
scope: All five original datasets and original condition axes retained, with all-cell-type extensions; no Mono-Micro restriction
